findings.claim: The round-1 fix for the missing kind was appended without editing the rule it replaces: rule (3) on the same line still reads kind_name = kinds_by_code.get(code).name (a None dereference for a deleted code), and the folder for a missing code is given two ways, '<kód>_' in the new sentence and AC and '<code>_neznamy_druh/' in Error Handling, so an agent that follows rule (3) or Error Handling still produces the 500 or fails the new AC.
findings.fix: Rewrite rule (3) itself: kind_name = fields_meta.druh_dokladu.kind_name, then kinds_by_code.get(code) with a None check, and state ONE folder name for a missing code (either '<kód>_' or '<kód>_neznamy_druh') in the rule, in Error Handling and in the AC alike.
